answer.sql_code:
SELECT ws.site_code,
       ws.name,
       COUNT(c.contract_id) AS nb_personnes_sous_contrat
FROM public.contracts c
JOIN public.departments d ON c.department_code = d.department_code
JOIN public.work_sites ws ON d.site_code = ws.site_code
WHERE c.start_date <= DATE '2026-05-31'
  AND (c.end_date IS NULL OR c.end_date >= DATE '2026-05-31')
GROUP BY ws.site_code, ws.name
ORDER BY ws.site_code
